transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. Lately I just feel like the future doesn’t hold much for me and that the meaningful part of my life is already over. My primary care doctor noticed this change in my outlook during a recent wellness visit and suggested I come in for an evaluation.
Have you been feeling this way consistently for at least two years, or is this a distinct change from how you felt previously?
Yes, it has been pretty constant for a little over three years now. It started creeping in after the initial excitement of my retirement wore off, and it has just stayed with me steadily ever since.
During these past three years, have there been any periods of a few weeks or more where your mood dropped significantly lower than your usual baseline and you lost interest in almost everything?

No, I haven't really had any sudden, severe drops or deeper episodes like that. It has just been a very steady, constant, low-grade "gray" feeling that has remained flat and unchanging since it first started.

This clinical picture is highly characteristic of F34.1, so the differential has been narrowed to this single candidate.
